Jana Name In Arabic Thuluth Calligraphy Description Jana is a beautiful and popular name with multiple origins. In Arabic, it means “harvest,” “fruits,” or “gathering,” symbolizing the reward of hard work and abundance. In Slavic languages, it is a variant of Jane, meaning “God is gracious.” The name carries a universal appeal, suggesting fruitfulness, grace, and natural beauty. It evokes a sense of fulfillment and gentle kindness.
